name: DS-Web Random Quotes for Kaamelott
author: dsweb73

sections.description:
In the spirit of Hello Dolly, this plugin displays a random line from Kaamelott on your site.

  • A “Kaamelott quote” block, with filters by book or character.
  • Quote of the day mode: the same quote for every visitor, changing at midnight.
  • A [rep-kaa] shortcode with its own settings page and built-in documentation.
  • Three display templates: full (quote, character, book, episode), character only, quote only.
  • Optional “Another quote” button, refreshed without reloading the page.
  • Page-cache friendly mode (quote picked in the browser).
  • Fonts bundled and served locally (no Google Fonts request): MedievalSharp, Uncial Antiqua and Luciole, a typeface designed for visually impaired readers. Papyrus is used when installed on the visitor’s device.
  • CSV import with duplicate detection.

No quotes are included. Add your own quotes manually or import them from a CSV file (see exemple-import.csv).

This is an unofficial fan plugin made by DS-Web. It is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Alexandre Astier, CALT Production or the rights holders of Kaamelott.

Credits

  • MedievalSharp by wmk69 – SIL Open Font License 1.1
  • Uncial Antiqua by Astigmatic – SIL Open Font License 1.1
  • Luciole by Laurent Bourcellier & Jonathan Perez – Creative Commons Attribution 4.0
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Kaamelott Quotes > Import (CSV) to import your quotes, or Kaamelott Quotes > Add quote to add them one by one.
  3. Insert the “Kaamelott quote” block, or use the [rep-kaa] shortcode (settings and parameters under Kaamelott Quotes > Settings).
sections.faq:
What CSV format is expected?

A header row replique;personnage;livre;episode (quote, character, book, episode), separator ; or ,, UTF-8 or Windows-1252. The book can be written “Livre II”, “Book II”, “II”, “2” or “Premier volet”.

Which shortcode parameters are available?

tirage (aleatoire, jour), police (medievalsharp, uncial, papyrus, luciole), modele (complet, personnage, replique), bouton (oui, non), livre, personnage, navigateur (oui, non). Example: [rep-kaa modele="personnage" bouton="non"].

Why does Papyrus not show up?

Papyrus is a commercial font and cannot be bundled. It is only displayed on devices where it is already installed (Windows, macOS); other visitors see MedievalSharp.

  • Faster random selection: matching quotes are cached, no more ORDER BY RAND() query.

1.0.0

  • First release.
